name: Retributive Strike
body:
You do not go quietly into that good night.

Prerequisite(s): Caster level 6

Benefit(s): As a free action, when you become unconscious, a burst of destruction emanates from you, dealing damage to creatures within 30 feet of you equal to 1d4/level of the highest level spell slot you have remaining. The spell slot is expended. A Reflex save (DC = 10 +1/2 caster level + Charisma bonus) is allowed for half damage. You may also use this feat when killed, increasing damage dice to d6s.
